judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the header search form's submit button (aria-label 'Enviar busca'). It has no border, background or text: the only thing that shows it is a magnifying-glass icon font glyph, 24x24 at about (848,84), inside the right end of the search field. I sampled the screenshot pixels there: the darkest icon pixels are #b3b3b3 on a #ffffff field, 2.10:1, and the live global.css still sets '.tr-header .searchBar .icon-search{color:#b3b3b3}', so the page has not changed. The button is not disabled, so the inactive exception does not apply. The icon is the visual information needed to identify this control, and 2.10:1 is below the 3:1 that 1.4.11 requires. Being able to submit with Enter does not exempt the button that is shown.
